conditions.label: latency-longer-limit · steps=10
conditions.description: The same delays with half as much time again to finish. If success recovers here, the failures under delay were slow episodes, not failed manipulation.

version: 1
name: latency-longer-limit
description: >
  The same delays with half as much time again to finish. If success recovers
  here, the failures under delay were slow episodes, not failed manipulation.
env: aloha/transfer_cube
episodes: 50
seed: 1000
max_steps: 600
sweep:
  name: steps
  values: [5, 10]
perturbations:
  - action_latency: { steps: "${steps}" }
tags: [timing, control]
